themes_detail.label: Sudden Street Hazards
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street signs spiked to 7 complaints this week versus a 0.5 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 1300% increase with a z-score of 9.19—suggesting rapid infrastructure deterioration in Crown Heights that poses public safety risks.
evidence: Street Sign - Dangling complaints: 7 this week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1300% spike)
Z-score of 9.19 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Street Condition complaints also surged to 42 this week vs. 7.6 average (451% increase, z-score 8.53)
reporting_angles: Walk neighborhoods and photograph dangling/fallen signs; identify which blocks are most affected
Interview DOT about response times and whether budget cuts are delaying maintenance

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints jumped to 28 this week versus a 7.0 weekly average—a 300% spike with z-score 4.7—indicating a potential surge in Uber/Lyft/TLC violations or congestion in Crown Heights this week.
evidence: For Hire Vehicle Complaint complaints: 28 this week vs. 7.0 weekly average (300% spike, z-score 4.7)
Surge coincides with peak spring travel season in NYC
Parking complaints remain chronically high at 2,064 over 90 days, suggesting transit pressure
reporting_angles: Survey Crown Heights residents and small business owners about congestion and idling for-hire vehicles
Analyze TLC complaint data and ticket issuances in the district over past two weeks

themes_detail.label: Park Animal Incidents
themes_detail.summary: Animal in a Park complaints surged to 5 this week versus a 0.6 weekly average—a 700% spike with z-score 5.11—potentially indicating wildlife encroachment or safety concerns in Prospect Heights parks.
evidence: Animal in a Park complaints: 5 this week vs. 0.6 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 5.11)
Related news peg: Brooklyn Eagle reported turtle rescue in Crown Heights on 2026-03-26
Community board budget requests include park reconstruction/upgrade, suggesting infrastructure issues may attract wildlife
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept. about species sightings, population concerns, and park maintenance in Prospect Heights
Follow up on the turtle rescue story—are there systemic animal-related issues in local parks?

themes_detail.label: Indoor Air Quality Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints jumped to 13 two weeks ago versus a 2.9 weekly average—a 352% spike with z-score 5.74—suggesting a cluster of HVAC failures, mold, or indoor pollution affecting residents.
evidence: Indoor Air Quality complaints: 13 two weeks ago vs. 2.9 weekly average (352% spike, z-score 5.74)
Heat/Hot Water complaints dominate at 3,823 over 90 days, suggesting building system problems extend beyond temperature control
Plumbing (627) and Water Leak (422) complaints also elevated, indicating broader building maintenance issues
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents about symptoms and whether they've contacted landlords or HPD; request inspection records
Analyze HPD violations filed in the district over past month to identify patterns in air quality citations

themes_detail.label: Sanitation System Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints surged to 6 two weeks ago versus a 0.8 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 5.42), while dirty condition complaints hit 79 versus 22.2 average (255% spike, z-score 4.87)—indicating a possible sanitation service disruption in Crown Heights.
evidence: Street Sweeping Complaint: 6 two weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 5.42)
Dirty Condition complaints: 79 two weeks ago vs. 22.2 weekly average (255% spike, z-score 4.87)
Unsanitary Condition complaints remain elevated at 669 over 90-day period
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY to confirm whether there were crew shortages, route changes, or service disruptions two weeks ago
Walk neighborhood blocks and assess current street cleanliness; identify if specific areas remain neglected
